seo.searchIntentSummary: Current product-page research shows commercial buyers respond best to a direct sequence: product purpose, visible or tactile result, verified construction choices, selection guidance, then artwork and quotation inputs. Golden One pages use this structure without importing competitor claims, prices, minimums, lead times, or unsupported manufacturing facts.

visual.heroDirection: Preserve the established Golden One homepage: a crisp teal-and-orange storefront led by sharply detailed pins, coins, medals, keychains, ribbons, hardware, and finish samples. Keep supporting pages solid, product-led, and free of the mother template's water and glass treatment.
visual.imageRules: Show the object at an aspirational scale: enamel color, edge depth, relief, plating, attachment, ribbon, leather grain, reverse side, and presentation. Treat every temporary image as a replaceable visual reference, never as proof of company work.

governance.notes: Golden One is the confirmed public brand and Golden One (Jiangmen) Gifts Co., Limited is the confirmed legal company name. The sales email, phone, WhatsApp, and Jiangmen address were supplied by the company on 2026-07-31. On 2026-09-08, owner-supplied product taxonomy, product media, and construction choices were mapped for product-page preparation; page imagery remains a product reference rather than proof of a specific completed order. Certifications, production capacity, prices, minimums, lead times, customer claims, and target-market claims remain unverified and must not be presented as facts.
